case_number: 2023 INSC ...; CRIMINAL APPEAL NO. ... OF 2023 (Arising out of SPECIAL LEAVE PETITION (CRL.) NO. 2063 OF 2023)
summary: Conviction upheld despite missing trial records; key issue: whether appellate court can sustain conviction without trial court records; standard: due process under Article 21 requires full record for meaningful appeal; Section 385 CrPC mandates record transmission; precedent from Hoskot, Abhai Raj Singh on reconstruction failure; conviction set aside for lack of fair procedure; Article 21 violation confirmed; dismissal penalty vacated.
legal_provisions_cited: Prevention of Corruption Act, 1988 s.7, s.13(1), s.13(2)
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; High Court judgment set aside; conviction quashed; Article 21 violation established.
